name: reqforge-greenkeeper
description: When maintaining the ReqForge repository itself and release gates fail: pnpm test, pnpm forge-smoke, pnpm sync:discover, adapter drift, skill fixture failures, or test-demo golden path failures
intent: Restore ReqForge's own repository gates to a green, synced state through evidence-based diagnosis, minimal fixes, adapter synchronization, and full verification
author: ReqForge

when: skill-fixtures, skills-complete, loadouts-valid, or test-demo-golden-path fails

commands.name: reqforge-greenkeeper
commands.description: Diagnose and fix ReqForge repository release gate failures
